global_style: An elegant, minimalist template utilizing Morandi purple tones, geometric circle motifs, and structured grids, ideal for academic or artistic presentations.

identity_anchors: Opposing corner decorations featuring overlapping solid and diagonally striped circles
Large central circular frames for section transitions
Muted Morandi purple color scheme with low-contrast, calming aesthetic
Use of elegant Serif typography for primary headings to establish a formal tone

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
